_comment: Each workspace's SuprSend `default` tenant — the brand every template resolves through {{$brand.*}}. Without this the tenant keeps whatever name the SuprSend account was created with, so every customer's email is signed by the notification vendor instead of the customer. The whole point of one workspace per customer is that Ember & Oak's mail says Ember & Oak and Nolan's says Nolan's Pizza. SuprSend now resolves these fields under `{{$tenant.*}}` as well as `{{$brand.*}}` — the two are interchangeable and return the same object. Templates here use `{{$brand.*}}` throughout, which is what the app has been tested against; pick one and stay with it rather than mixing them. Colours match each workspace's accent in lib/workspaces.ts so the app chrome and the email agree; edit any of it in Admin → Brand Settings, which writes back to the same tenant.
